Let me re-think this more carefully based on what's natural for a "room packer":

The user wants: multiple selected squares must always form a rectangle. So:
1. There is one "active rectangle" tracked as `(rMin, cMin, rMax, cMax)`
2. **Click a new cell** → expand the bounding rectangle to include it

Actually, the simplest and most intuitive interpretation: the selection is always exactly one rectangle. Dragging sets it. Clicking a cell outside the current rectangle **expands** the rectangle to include it. Clicking a cell inside the rectangle doesn't make sense to "shrink" because you'd break rectangle integrity — so a click on a selected cell could clear the whole selection, or we ignore it.

The cleanest UX:
- The selection is always a single rectangle stored as `{rMin, cMin, rMax, cMax}`
- **Drag** → rubber-band sets a new rectangle (replaces the old one)
- **Single click on unselected cell** → expand the existing rectangle to include that cell (or start a new one if none exists)
- **Single click on selected cell** → clear the entire selection
- The preview during drag shows the bounding box of (existing selection ∪ drag rectangle)

### Rules
The selection is always **exactly one rectangle** (or nothing).

| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| **Click an empty cell** (no selection) | Starts a new 1×1 selection |
| **Click an empty cell** (selection exists) | Expands the rectangle to the smallest bounding box containing the existing selection **and** the new cell |

| **Drag** (selection exists) | Live preview shows the bounding box of the existing selection **union** the drag rectangle — the whole thing snaps to the smallest enclosing rect |
| **Click inside the selection** | Clears the entire selection |

So if you select a 3×3 block in one corner and then click a cell far away, the selection automatically expands to bridge the gap — always staying a valid rectangle.

<script>
      const CELL = 12;
      const SIZE = 64;

      const board    = document.getElementById("board");
      const overlay  = document.getElementById("overlay");
      const btnTable = document.getElementById("btn-table");

      const TABLE_COLORS = [
        "#e07b54","#5b9bd5","#e8a838","#8e6bbf",
        "#4caf8a","#d95f8a","#6ab04c","#c0392b",
      ];
      let tableCount = 0;

      // ── Build grid ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      const cells = [];
      for (let row = 0; row < SIZE; row++) {
        cells[row] = [];
        for (let col = 0; col < SIZE; col++) {
          const cell = document.createElement("div");
          cell.classList.add("cell");
          cell.classList.add((row + col) % 2 === 0 ? "light" : "dark");
          cell.dataset.row = row;
          cell.dataset.col = col;
          cells[row][col] = cell;
          board.appendChild(cell);
        }
      }

      // ── Selection ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      let selection = null;
      let isDragging = false, dragStartRow = null, dragStartCol = null;

      function clearClass(cls) {
        board.querySelectorAll("." + cls).forEach(c => c.classList.remove(cls));
      }

      function paintRect(rMin, cMin, rMax, cMax, cls) {
        for (let r = rMin; r <= rMax; r++)
          for (let c = cMin; c <= cMax; c++)
            cells[r][c].classList.add(cls);
      }

      function renderSelection() {
        clearClass("selected");
        if (selection) paintRect(selection.rMin, selection.cMin, selection.rMax, selection.cMax, "selected");
        btnTable.disabled = !selection;
      }

      function previewRect(curRow, curCol) {
        const dr1 = Math.min(dragStartRow, curRow), dr2 = Math.max(dragStartRow, curRow);
        const dc1 = Math.min(dragStartCol, curCol), dc2 = Math.max(dragStartCol, curCol);
        if (!selection) return { rMin: dr1, cMin: dc1, rMax: dr2, cMax: dc2 };
        return {
          rMin: Math.min(selection.rMin, dr1), cMin: Math.min(selection.cMin, dc1),
          rMax: Math.max(selection.rMax, dr2), cMax: Math.max(selection.cMax, dc2),
        };
      }

      function applyPreview(curRow, curCol) {
        clearClass("preview");
        const r = previewRect(curRow, curCol);
        paintRect(r.rMin, r.cMin, r.rMax, r.cMax, "preview");
      }

      // ── Mouse events ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      board.addEventListener("dragstart", (e) => e.preventDefault());

      board.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const cell = e.target.closest(".cell");
        if (!cell) return;
        isDragging = true;
        dragStartRow = parseInt(cell.dataset.row);
        dragStartCol = parseInt(cell.dataset.col);
        applyPreview(dragStartRow, dragStartCol);
      });

      board.addEventListener("mouseover", (e) => {
        if (!isDragging) return;
        const cell = e.target.closest(".cell");
        if (!cell) return;
        applyPreview(parseInt(cell.dataset.row), parseInt(cell.dataset.col));
      });

      document.addEventListener("mouseup", (e) => {
        if (!isDragging) return;
        const el   = document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        const cell = el && el.closest(".cell");
        clearClass("preview");
        if (cell) {
          const endRow = parseInt(cell.dataset.row);
          const endCol = parseInt(cell.dataset.col);
          const r = previewRect(endRow, endCol);
          const isSingleClick = dragStartRow === endRow && dragStartCol === endCol;
          if (isSingleClick && selection &&
              endRow >= selection.rMin && endRow <= selection.rMax &&
              endCol >= selection.cMin && endCol <= selection.cMax) {
            selection = null;
          } else {
            selection = r;
          }
          renderSelection();
        }
        isDragging = false; dragStartRow = null; dragStartCol = null;
      });

      // ── Place Table ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      function placeTable() {
        if (!selection) return;
        const { rMin, cMin, rMax, cMax } = selection;
        const color = TABLE_COLORS[tableCount % TABLE_COLORS.length];
        const label = `Table ${tableCount + 1}`;
        tableCount++;

        // Stamp cell colours
        for (let r = rMin; r <= rMax; r++) {
          for (let c = cMin; c <= cMax; c++) {
            const cell = cells[r][c];
            cell.classList.remove("selected", "light", "dark", "preview");
            cell.style.backgroundColor = color;
            cell.style.opacity = "0.85";
          }
        }

        // Label overlay
        const div = document.createElement("div");
        div.className = "table-rect";
        div.style.left            = (cMin * CELL) + "px";
        div.style.top             = (rMin * CELL) + "px";
        div.style.width           = ((cMax - cMin + 1) * CELL) + "px";
        div.style.height          = ((rMax - rMin + 1) * CELL) + "px";
        div.style.backgroundColor = color + "44";
        div.style.borderColor     = color;
        div.textContent = label;
        overlay.appendChild(div);

        selection = null;
        renderSelection();
      }

      btnTable.addEventListener("click", placeTable);
      document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (e.key === "t" || e.key === "T") placeTable();
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

      function applySelPreview(curRow,curCol) {
        clearClass("preview");
        const r = selPreviewRect(curRow,curCol);
        paintRect(r.rMin,r.cMin,r.rMax,r.cMax,"preview");
      }

      // ── Cell colour helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
      function resetCell(r,c) {
        const cell = cells[r][c];
        cell.style.backgroundColor = "";
        cell.style.opacity = "";
        cell.classList.remove("selected","preview");
        cell.classList.add((r+c)%2===0 ? "light" : "dark");
        tableGrid[r][c] = null;
      }
      function stampTable(t) {
        for (let r=t.rMin;r<=t.rMax;r++) for (let c=t.cMin;c<=t.cMax;c++) {
          const cell = cells[r][c];
          cell.classList.remove("selected","light","dark","preview");
          cell.style.backgroundColor = t.color;
          cell.style.opacity = "0.85";
          tableGrid[r][c] = t.id;
        }
      }
      function eraseTable(t) {
        for (let r=t.rMin;r<=t.rMax;r++) for (let c=t.cMin;c<=t.cMax;c++) resetCell(r,c);
      }

      // Position the overlay div for a table
      function positionEl(t) {
        t.el.style.left   = (t.cMin * CELL) + "px";
        t.el.style.top    = (t.rMin * CELL) + "px";
        t.el.style.width  = ((t.cMax - t.cMin + 1) * CELL) + "px";
        t.el.style.height = ((t.rMax - t.rMin + 1) * CELL) + "px";
      }

      // ── Place Table ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      function placeTable() {
        if (!selection) return;
        const { rMin, cMin, rMax, cMax } = selection;
        const color = TABLE_COLORS[tableCount % TABLE_COLORS.length];
        const id    = tableCount++;
        const label = `Table ${id + 1}`;

        const el = document.createElement("div");
        el.className = "table-rect";
        el.style.backgroundColor = color + "44";
        el.style.borderColor = color;
        el.textContent = label;

        const t = { id, rMin, cMin, rMax, cMax, color, label, el };
        tables.push(t);
        positionEl(t);
        stampTable(t);
        overlay.appendChild(el);

        // Attach drag listener to the overlay div
        el.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => onTableMouseDown(e, t));

        selection = null;
        renderSelection();
      }

      btnTable.addEventListener("click", placeTable);
      document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key==="t"||e.key==="T") placeTable(); });

      // ── Table drag ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      let movingTable   = null;
      let moveOffsetRow = 0, moveOffsetCol = 0;  // click offset within table
      let ghost         = null;

      function boardCoordsFromEvent(e) {
        const rect = boardWrap.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
        const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
        return {
          col: Math.floor(x / CELL),
          row: Math.floor(y / CELL),
        };
      }

      function clampTable(rMin, cMin, rMax, cMax) {
        // Keep inside board
        let dr = 0, dc = 0;
        if (rMin < 0) dr = -rMin;
        if (cMin < 0) dc = -cMin;
        if (rMax >= SIZE) dr = SIZE - 1 - rMax;
        if (cMax >= SIZE) dc = SIZE - 1 - cMax;
        return { rMin: rMin+dr, cMin: cMin+dc, rMax: rMax+dr, cMax: cMax+dc };
      }

      function onTableMouseDown(e, t) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();  // don't trigger board selection

        const { row, col } = boardCoordsFromEvent(e);
        moveOffsetRow = row - t.rMin;
        moveOffsetCol = col - t.cMin;
        movingTable   = t;

        t.el.classList.add("moving");

        // Create ghost
        ghost = document.createElement("div");
        ghost.className = "table-ghost";
        ghost.style.width  = ((t.rMax - t.rMin + 1) * CELL) + "px";  // swap intentional below
        ghost.style.width  = ((t.cMax - t.cMin + 1) * CELL) + "px";
        ghost.style.height = ((t.rMax - t.rMin + 1) * CELL) + "px";
        ghost.style.left   = t.el.style.left;
        ghost.style.top    = t.el.style.top;
        overlay.appendChild(ghost);
      }

      document.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
        if (!movingTable) return;
        const { row, col } = boardCoordsFromEvent(e);
        const h = movingTable.rMax - movingTable.rMin;
        const w = movingTable.cMax - movingTable.cMin;
        const { rMin, cMin, rMax, cMax } = clampTable(
          row - moveOffsetRow, col - moveOffsetCol,
          row - moveOffsetRow + h, col - moveOffsetCol + w
        );
        // Move ghost to snapped position
        ghost.style.left   = (cMin * CELL) + "px";
        ghost.style.top    = (rMin * CELL) + "px";
        // Also float the actual label div with the mouse (pixel-exact, feels responsive)
        movingTable.el.style.left = (cMin * CELL) + "px";
        movingTable.el.style.top  = (rMin * CELL) + "px";
      });

      document.addEventListener("mouseup", (e) => {
        if (!movingTable) return;
        const t = movingTable;
        const { row, col } = boardCoordsFromEvent(e);
        const h = t.rMax - t.rMin;
        const w = t.cMax - t.cMin;
        const snapped = clampTable(
          row - moveOffsetRow, col - moveOffsetCol,
          row - moveOffsetRow + h, col - moveOffsetCol + w
        );

        // Erase old cells
        eraseTable(t);

        // Commit new position
        t.rMin = snapped.rMin; t.cMin = snapped.cMin;
        t.rMax = snapped.rMax; t.cMax = snapped.cMax;

        stampTable(t);
        positionEl(t);

        t.el.classList.remove("moving");
        overlay.removeChild(ghost);
        ghost = null;
        movingTable = null;
      });

      // ── Board selection mouse events ─────────────────────────────────────────
      board.addEventListener("dragstart", (e) => e.preventDefault());

      board.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
        if (movingTable) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const cell = e.target.closest(".cell");
        if (!cell) return;
        const row = parseInt(cell.dataset.row), col = parseInt(cell.dataset.col);
        if (tableGrid[row][col] !== null) return;   // don't select over a table
        isSelecting = true;
        selStartRow = row; selStartCol = col;
        applySelPreview(row, col);
      });

      board.addEventListener("mouseover", (e) => {
        if (!isSelecting) return;
        const cell = e.target.closest(".cell");
        if (!cell) return;
        applySelPreview(parseInt(cell.dataset.row), parseInt(cell.dataset.col));
      });

      document.addEventListener("mouseup", (e) => {
        if (!isSelecting) return;
        const el   = document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        const cell = el && el.closest(".cell");
        clearClass("preview");
        if (cell) {
          const endRow = parseInt(cell.dataset.row);
          const endCol = parseInt(cell.dataset.col);
          const r = selPreviewRect(endRow, endCol);
          const isSingleClick = selStartRow===endRow && selStartCol===endCol;
          if (isSingleClick && selection &&
              endRow>=selection.rMin && endRow<=selection.rMax &&
              endCol>=selection.cMin && endCol<=selection.cMax) {
            selection = null;
          } else {
            selection = r;
          }
          renderSelection();
        }
        isSelecting = false; selStartRow = null; selStartCol = null;
      }, true); // capture phase so this fires even if movingTable mouseup fires first
    </script>
